en.title: 2026 Outlook: AI apps are getting harder to build—so where can ordinary people still make money?
en.summary: Funding for AI app startups is tightening, leaving many indie developers and founders unsure where to focus. This piece skips the crowded foundational infrastructure race and lays out two practical directions for ordinary people. Rather than chasing the latest tech hype, start with real consumer pain points close to home — and even non-experts can find an AI business opportunity that fits them.

items_all.title: AI 浏览器退潮，TTY 翻红：从远程连接、技术抉择到 Agent 时代的基础设施演进
items_all.summary: 这篇文章拆解了一个有意思的行业反转：曾经热度拉满的AI浏览器逐步退潮，古老的TTY终端反而在AI编程Agent场景重回主流。文中梳理了SSH、Mosh、Web-PTY、tmux等方案的优劣边界，给出了清晰的自研红线，同时还给出了配套的隔离方案、密钥治理、移动端远程接管的选型思路，或许可以帮你少走弯路。

en.title: AI Browsers Lose Steam, TTY Makes a Comeback: From Remote Connections and Technical Choices to Infrastructure Evolution in the Agent Era
en.summary: This piece unpacks a curious industry reversal: AI browsers, once hyped to the max, are ebbing, while the age-old TTY terminal is back in the mainstream for AI coding Agent work. It walks through where SSH, Mosh, Web-PTY, tmux and similar options each shine and where they break down, draws clear red lines for building your own, and lays out supporting choices around isolation, key governance, and mobile remote takeover—which may help you avoid a few wrong turns.

items_all.title: MUSE 进阶实战：从锁脸出片到控运镜，搭一套完整的 AI 视频流水线
items_all.summary: 如果你刚接触 Meta 的个人 AI 助手 Muse，平时可能只用它聊聊天、查资料，或者试着生成过一两张图片。但当你真的想用它做一条「能发出去的完整短视频」时，大概率会遇到人物换脸、肢体畸变、长视频慢放、额度消耗快等高频坑点。作者这篇文章分享了一些对应的解决办法，可以试试！

en.title: MUSE Advanced Guide: From Locking Faces to Controlling Camera Moves, Building a Complete AI Video Pipeline
en.summary: If you're new to Meta's personal AI assistant Muse, you've probably only used it to chat, look things up, or generate the occasional image. But once you actually try to produce a complete short video you'd be willing to publish, you'll likely hit the usual pain points: faces swapping, distorted limbs, slow playback on longer videos, and credits draining fast. The author shares some fixes for each — worth a try.

en.title: Which Chinese models are swimming naked? Five models, 10 case studies, 50 rounds of hands-on task testing
en.summary: Over the past few days, Mengfei ran a head-to-head comparison of five leading Chinese models, and today we're sharing the results. The lineup: Doubao Seed evolving, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi-K3.1pro, GLM-5.3-flash, and Tencent HY4. Each model built 6 web pages and then took on 4 long-horizon engineering tasks — 50 rounds of testing in total. Let's see how they did!
